verseOfMonth.text: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.

featuredEvent.title: Fire Safety Evening — TODAY!
featuredEvent.summary: TODAY! Join us from 5:00–7:00 PM for a FREE community Fire Safety Evening. Montgomery Fire Department and Boomer Fire Department will be with us! Come meet our local firefighters, learn about fire safety, enjoy family-friendly activities, and get FREE hotdogs and drinks provided by CMBC. Bring the family — everyone is welcome!
